mutations.name: Octokit's throttle, not the pool, owns the bot's rate-limit waits
kills: bot identity: the reconciler's pool owns rate-limit waits (TP-3431) answers a secondary-limited read at once, unretried, so Octokit's throttle never sleeps under the pool

mutations.name: the bot's ls-remote sends no token
kills: bot identity: ls-remote as the bot (TP-3431) hands the reconciler the bot's login and an ls-remote that sends the bot's own token, off argv
